comments.value:
The only way would be to completely remove custom shader support, which obviously wouldn't fly at all. It's impossible to just selectively hinder screenspace functions on uploaded shaders.

Also since you seem unaware of it, you can just use custom settings on your safety system to disallow shaders/particles on trusted users.

Best I can suggest, run around with custom animations off. Most crashes will not have crashing animations on permanently because it would just backfire. If they can’t use the animation on your side them it can’t be activated to crash you.

"safety settings don't help" are you joking right? with safety you are allowed to hide every model, also u can disable shaders or custom animations for everyone... i don't see the problem with it
even if u hide everyone's model they still can crash you with clients so i don't get why being so annoying against the screen shaders
Just have avatars blocked. It's really that easy. I'm in public worlds a lot and dont run into this often. Maybe look at who youre hanging around with too.

@{5c1d007d3d7a0912aaff65e8|full_name}: That's not a solution to screenspace shaders being extremely abuseable, more than any other shader type about.
Sure you can block every avatar, but the game is considerably worse that way you may as well not even play.
Screenspace shaders are used almost exclusively for the kind of avatars you end up blocking.

@{5bafbca9282d5d55fb6899f8|full_name}: It is a solution. It's one of 2 solutions actually. That's why the implimented the safety system in the first place, the only other thing you can do is learn the name of the shader, let the devs know and they can try to black list it. Sure the shades can be abused and be annoying but there are just as many people that do cool creative stuff with them as there are people who just want to be crazy. Use the safety system, that's what it's there for.

You can disable shaders for everyone. Then as you meet people, you can actually go into the menu and click the Show Avatar button which overrides your safety settings and enables everything for them. Doing this one at a time makes it easier to undo and block someone if an abusive "blinder" shader is on. I used to just have avatars off for everyone and then enable them one at a time as I approach people.

@{5bd385cc1d98246cdedebf61|full_name}: I don't want to block everything and see a bunch of default robot avatars. I want to see the avatars of legitimate users, and block only screen space shaders. Ideally, screen space shaders should just be disallowed and blocked for everyone.

no man, screenshader are a thing in this community and if they would remove them... they'll ruin some marketing in the game. You just hate toxic animations and i do understand but removing them is not an option

Unless developers would manually greenlight each and every avatar, that wouldn't be really possible. Even if there was a restriction in how big that "Shader sphere" can be, you could still bother people with a smaller version.

You have safety settings, you have performance limiter. I'd argue those two things already do a great job at preventing what you just said. Simply disable custom animations and 99% of your problems will be gone.

@{5d6caf30b0a60836663faee4|full_name}: Simply disable custom animations for every rank except friends and you avoid 99% of all problems. Seriously, most annoying things are tied to custom animations so disabling those means people can't spawn in their bad effects.
@{5c540514d859d512a8d1d2f9|full_name}: How do you disable only shaders?
yes please! i know hiding shaders solves this.. but i wish there was more balance of selecting of what can be done and what cannot.
checking if shader is using screenspace is quite easy
The first time this happened to me was quite jarring, I wholly agree that this needs to be sorted out.

details: Quite frankly it's ridiculous that it's trivial for people to crash everyone or make the game unusable. Fairly often I've found that the users who do this are already "Trusted Users" so the safety settings don't help. Why not straight up just... don't allow this to happen? Any avatar that can crash other players or blacken the screen of other players should be removed from VRChat, it's ridiculous that this is a problem.
title: Don't allow avatars to alter the screens of other players
